checks.name: Published hub initializes all nine themes and a separate identity card; native search has a visible label and polite result count
Search matches trimmed case-insensitive name and visible description substrings, preserves order and restores all nine when input clears
Matching uses visible theme names/descriptions without extra badge, decorative-study, CTA or brand matches; literal markup produces zero results without execution
Clear recovers from zero results, resets count and query, and returns focus to the search field
A native-search clear input event restores all themes, including the grid-displayed Layered card
Keyboard tab order reaches search, Clear and the matching preview link without visiting hidden theme links
mobile-light matches and zero-results states fit a 320px viewport with usable native controls
mobile-dark matches and zero-results states fit a 320px viewport with usable native controls
mobile-forced-colors matches and zero-results states fit a 320px viewport with usable native controls
javascript-disabled preserves all nine theme links and identity while runtime-only controls are hidden or disabled
script-blocked preserves all nine theme links and identity while runtime-only controls are hidden or disabled
Published subpath resources load without runtime errors, external requests or ordinary failed resources

limits: Headless Chromium on Windows only. No assistive-technology session, user study, native browser zoom, or other browser engine.
Focus, status semantics, keyboard behavior and rendered styles are inspected; this is bounded evidence, not an accessibility conformance claim.
No theme preview behavior is changed or revalidated here. Build links and targeted hub behavior are checked.
